repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 公开 Claude 智能体技能库，提供文档处理、开发工具、企业工作流等多样化技能模板，支持动态加载与自定义扩展，助力 AI 智能体实现专业化任务自动化。
repos.summary_en: Anthropic's public repository for Agent Skills provides Claude with dynamic, modular capabilities across document processing, development tools, and enterprise workflows, enabling specialized task automation through customizable, production-grade skill modules.

repos.description: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
repos.summary_zh: prompts.chat 是全球最大的开源提示词库，涵盖 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。提供社区驱动的提示词分享与收集平台，支持免费使用及私有化部署，兼具学术引用价值与工业级实用性。
repos.summary_en: Prompts.chat is the world's largest open-source prompt library for AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It offers a community-driven platform to share, discover, and collect prompts, with free public access and self-hosting options for organizations seeking privacy.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了30,000+行关于主流AI编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI等）的系统提示、内部工具和模型架构的深度解析，涵盖其设计理念、功能实现与技术细节，为开发者提供全面的AI编程助手技术洞察与最佳实践参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: 🤯 LobeHub - Super-Agents on Your Team. Add super-agents to the chats your team already uses.They take on work by themselves and get better every week.
repos.summary_zh: LobeHub 是一个面向工作与生活的终极协作空间，致力于构建人类与智能体协同进化的网络。该平台支持多智能体协作、无代码团队设计，并提供智能搜索、知识库、语音交互、插件系统等强大功能，打造下一代 AI 驱动的生产力工具生态。
repos.summary_en: LobeHub is the ultimate workspace for human-agent collaboration, enabling multi-agent teamwork, effortless agent orchestration, and co-evolution between humans and AI. It features smart search, knowledge bases, voice interaction, plugin systems, and a growing ecosystem of agent teammates designed to enhance productivity.

repos.description: ChatGPT 中文调教指南。各种场景使用指南。学习怎么让它听你的话。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供全面的 ChatGPT 中文调教指南，涵盖学术论文、创意写作、商业文案、翻译、数据分析等 20+ 应用场景，帮助用户掌握提示词技巧，让 AI 高效完成各类任务，提升工作效率与内容质量。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive guide to prompting ChatGPT in Chinese, covering over 20 use cases including academic writing, creative content, business communication, translation, and data analysis. It empowers users to master prompt engineering and leverage AI for enhanced productivity and content quality.

repos.description: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力工作室，集成智能聊天、自主代理和300+助手，提供统一接口访问主流大语言模型，支持多语言界面与跨平台部署，适用于个人及企业级智能工作流构建。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity studio featuring smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants with unified access to leading LLMs. It supports multi-language interfaces and cross-platform deployment for building intelligent workflows at personal or enterprise level.

repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、开发工具、数据分析、商业营销等十大领域。通过 Composio 插件，Claude 可连接500+应用执行真实操作（如发邮件、创建工单），实现从文本生成到自动化工作的跨越。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of practical workflows for enhancing Claude AI across platforms. It covers document processing, development tools, data analysis, business automation, and more. With the Composio plugin, Claude can connect to 500+ apps to perform real-world actions like sending emails or creating issues, extending beyond text generation.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: Chatbox 是一款跨平台桌面 AI 客户端，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等主流大模型，提供多端同步、插件扩展、提示工程优化等功能，适用于开发者、研究人员和AI爱好者的高效生产力工具。
repos.summary_en: Chatbox is a powerful cross-platform desktop AI client supporting ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. It offers multi-device sync, plugin support, prompt engineering, and advanced customization for developers and AI enthusiasts.

repos.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
repos.summary_zh: 女娲.skill 是一个 AI 技能蒸馏工具，通过分析公开资料提取顶尖人物的认知框架、决策启发式和表达模式，让用户直接调用乔布斯、马斯克等名人的思维方式解决实际问题。核心功能包括五层心智模型提取（表达DNA、认知框架、决策启发式、反模式、诚实边界），支持一键安装并已在 Claude Code 中验证可用性。
repos.summary_en: Nuwa.skill is an AI agent that distills the cognitive frameworks, decision heuristics, and communication patterns of top-tier individuals like Jobs, Musk, and Zhang Xuefeng from public data. It enables users to invoke these distilled mental models directly in Claude Code for problem-solving. The system extracts five layers of thinking patterns (expression DNA, cognitive architecture, judgment heuristics, anti-patterns, and honest boundaries) with clear limitations on what cannot be captured.

repos.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.description: leaked prompts of GPTs
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收集了多个泄露的 GPTs 提示词（prompts），涵盖开发、翻译、娱乐、教育、图像生成、视频脚本、游戏等多个领域，展示了 OpenAI GPTs 功能的广泛应用场景与技术实现方式。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles leaked prompts from various GPTs, covering development, translation, entertainment, education, image generation, video scripting, gaming, and more, showcasing diverse use cases and technical implementations of OpenAI's GPTs platform.

repos.description: 410 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (120+ Agents, custom commands, 410+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.
repos.summary_zh: Claude Skills & Plugins 是开源的 AI 编码工具增强库，提供205个生产级技能包，覆盖工程、产品、营销、合规及高管咨询等领域。支持11种主流AI开发工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI），所有Python工具均为stdlib-only，无需额外依赖。通过模块化指令包和CLI脚本实现跨领域专家能力扩展。
repos.summary_en: Claude Skills & Plugins is an open-source library offering 205 production-ready agent skills for 11 AI coding tools, including Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It provides reusable domain expertise in engineering, marketing, compliance, and C-level advisory via modular instruction packages and zero-pip Python tools. All components are cross-platform and tool-agnostic.

repos.description: A GPT-4 AI Tutor Prompt for customizable personalized learning experiences.
repos.summary_zh: Mr. Ranedeer 是一个专为 GPT-4 设计的个性化 AI 导师提示词，支持深度知识定制、学习风格调整与多模态交互，适用于编程、数学、文学等多种学科的教学辅导。
repos.summary_en: Mr. Ranedeer is a customizable GPT-4 prompt engineered as a personalized AI tutor, enabling tailored learning experiences with adaptive depth, communication style, and reasoning frameworks across diverse subjects.

repos.description: Distilly — Distill how they think into reusable Skills for any Agent or Bot. Formerly Colleague Skill（原同事 Skill）.
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: 将冰冷的离别化为温暖的 Skill，欢迎加入数字生命1.0！Transforming cold farewells into warm skills? It's giving rebirth era. Welcome to Digital Life 1.0. 🫶
repos.summary_zh: 同事.skill 是一款基于 AgentSkills 标准的 AI 智能体工具，通过分析飞书、钉钉、邮件等数据源，生成具备真实工作能力和人物性格的 AI Skill。它能模拟离职同事的技术规范、代码风格与沟通方式，实现知识传承与数字永生，适用于企业知识管理、新人培训和协作连续性维护。
repos.summary_en: Colleague.skill is an AI agent tool built on the AgentSkills standard that generates realistic AI skills by analyzing data sources like Feishu, DingTalk, and emails. It simulates a departed colleague's technical expertise, coding style, and communication patterns to enable knowledge transfer and digital continuity in workplaces.

repos.description: 面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，吴恩达大模型系列课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，基于吴恩达大模型系列课程打造，覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、模型微调等全流程。内容涵盖从基础 API 调用到 LangChain 应用开发，提供中文复现代码与 Prompt 优化方案，支持 Jupyter Notebook 实践，助力开发者快速掌握 LLM 应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a developer-focused LLM入门教程 based on Andrew Ng's large language model courses, covering Prompt Engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning. It includes translated, reproduced code examples and optimized Chinese prompts, enabling hands-on learning via Jupyter Notebooks to help developers master LLM application development.

repos.description: 🚀✨ Minimalistic, powerful and extremely customizable Zsh prompt
repos.summary_zh: Spaceship Prompt 是一款极简、强大且高度可定制的 Zsh 终端提示符，提供丰富的信息展示，包括 Git 状态、多语言运行时环境、包版本、电池电量、Kubernetes 上下文等，支持深度自定义配置，显著提升终端使用体验。
repos.summary_en: Spaceship Prompt is a minimalistic, powerful, and highly customizable Zsh prompt that displays essential information like Git status, runtime environments (Node.js, Python, etc.), package versions, battery level, and Kubernetes context, with extensive customization options for enhanced terminal productivity.

repos.description: 自动化上传视频到社交媒体：抖音、小红书、视频号、tiktok、youtube、bilibili
repos.summary_zh: social-auto-upload 是一个多平台视频自动化上传工具，支持抖音、小红书、B站、快手、视频号、TikTok等主流社交媒体的视频与图文内容一键发布。采用无头浏览器技术实现隐蔽操作，提供 CLI 和 AI Agent 双模式支持，具备定时发布、账号管理等功能，专为内容创作者解决跨平台分发效率痛点。
repos.summary_en: social-auto-upload is a powerful automation tool that enables one-click video and image uploads to major social media platforms including Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Kuaishou, TikTok, and more. It uses headless browser technology for stealthy operations, supports both CLI and AI Agent modes, and features scheduled publishing and account management to streamline content distribution across platforms.

repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows — particularly Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、创意设计、开发工具等官方及社区贡献的技能包。通过模块化设计支持动态加载，显著提升 Claude Code 在文件操作、网页构建和自动化任务中的效率，适用于企业级 AI 工作流定制。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of Claude AI skills covering document processing, creative design, and development tools. Featuring modular dynamic loading, it enhances Claude Code's efficiency in file operations, web artifact generation, and automation tasks for enterprise-grade AI workflow customization.

repos.description: A gallery that showcases on-device ML/GenAI use cases and allows people to try and use models locally.
repos.summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 是一个展示端侧机器学习与生成式 AI 应用的实验性应用，支持在 Android 和 iOS 设备上本地运行大模型，提供离线聊天、图像问答、音频转录、提示工程等功能，并集成 Tiny Garden 小游戏与设备控制能力，实现完全离线的智能体验。
repos.summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery is an experimental app showcasing on-device ML/GenAI use cases, enabling users to run generative AI models locally on Android and iOS. It supports offline chat, image Q&A, audio transcription, prompt engineering, and includes a mini game and device control via fine-tuned models, all without requiring an internet connection.

repos.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repos.summary_zh: 专为AI代理设计的营销技能集，涵盖CRO、文案撰写、SEO、数据分析和增长工程。基于Agent Skills规范构建，支持Claude Code等主流编码代理，为技术型营销人员和创始人提供自动化营销解决方案，通过标准化技能文件实现跨平台协作与知识复用。
repos.summary_en: A collection of AI agent skills for marketing tasks including CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built on the Agent Skills spec for use with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other agents. Provides standardized workflows for technical marketers and founders to automate conversion optimization, content creation, and growth strategies.

repos.description: Memory for 24/7 proactive agents like openclaw (moltbot, clawdbot).
repos.summary_zh: memU 是一个专为 24/7 主动式 AI 代理设计的内存框架，将内存建模为文件系统，支持层级分类、跨引用和持久化存储。它通过结构化记忆减少 LLM 令牌成本，实现持续理解用户意图并主动执行任务，适用于 openclaw、moltbot 等长期运行代理。
repos.summary_en: memU is a memory framework for 24/7 proactive AI agents, modeling memory as a file system with hierarchical categories, cross-references, and persistent storage. It reduces LLM token costs by caching insights and enables continuous understanding of user intent, making always-on agents practical for production systems like openclaw and moltbot.

repos.description: 把书、长视频、播客等高价值内容蒸馏成可执行的 Agent Skills（Distill high-value content from books, long-form videos, podcasts, and more into executable Agent Skills）
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: LangGPT: Empowering everyone to become a prompt expert! 🚀  📌 结构化提示词（Structured Prompt）提出者 📌 元提示词（Meta-Prompt）发起者   📌 最流行的提示词落地范式 | Language of GPT  The pioneering framework for structured & meta-prompt design 10,000+ ⭐ | Battle-tested by thousands of users worldwide  Created by 云中江树
repos.summary_zh: LangGPT 是一个革命性的结构化提示词设计框架，将提示词工程转化为可复用、模块化的‘提示词编程语言’。通过角色定义、目标规范、技能拆解和流程控制，帮助用户快速创建高质量 AI 提示词，已在全球超万名用户中验证有效，相关论文发表于 arXiv。
repos.summary_en: LangGPT is a pioneering framework that treats prompt design as a structured, reusable programming language. It enables anyone to create high-quality prompts through role-based templates, modular skills, and systematic workflows, backed by academic research and battle-tested by 10,000+ users worldwide.

repos.description: A collection of GPT system prompts and various prompt injection/leaking knowledge.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了 ChatGPT 和自定义 GPTs 的多样化系统提示词，涵盖教育、编程、安全等多个领域。通过公开优质提示词案例，帮助开发者提升提示工程能力，同时揭示提示注入与安全防护策略，推动 AI 应用安全实践。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles diverse system prompts for ChatGPT and custom GPTs across education, programming, and security domains. It enhances prompt engineering skills through real-world examples while exposing prompt injection vulnerabilities and defense strategies to promote secure AI application development.

repos.description: 张雪峰.skill — 张雪峰的认知操作系统。高考志愿/考研/职业规划的实战思维框架。由女娲.skill生成。
repos.summary_zh: 张雪峰.skill 是基于张雪峰真实言论与人生轨迹构建的认知操作系统，提炼出5大核心心智模型与8条决策启发式。通过分析家庭背景、就业中位数、社会筛选机制等维度，为高考志愿、考研择校、职业规划提供实战思维框架，强调阶层现实与不可替代性判断。
repos.summary_en: Zhang Xuefeng.skill is a cognitive operating system distilled from his real speeches and life trajectory, featuring 5 core mental models and 8 decision heuristics. It provides practical frameworks for college major selection, postgraduate planning, and career advice by analyzing family resources, employment median outcomes, and social filtering mechanisms, emphasizing class realism and irreplaceability.

repos.description: Stop writing prompts from scratch — a searchable prompt library for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Cursor · Русский 한국어 العربية हिन्दी ไทย ｜ 别再从头写提示词：现成的拿来就用，好用的收进自己的库
repos.summary_zh: AiShort 是一款高效的 AI 提示词管理工具，提供海量精选提示词库，支持一键复制、智能搜索与多语言适配。用户可自定义标签分类、收藏常用提示词，并通过社区分享优质内容。配合浏览器插件实现跨平台的快捷调用，显著提升 AI 交互效率。
repos.summary_en: AiShort is an AI prompt management tool that offers a curated library of prompts for quick access and productivity enhancement. It supports smart search, custom tagging, community sharing, and browser extension integration for seamless use across platforms.

repos.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
repos.summary_zh: Impeccable 是一个专为 AI 前端设计优化的提示工程框架，基于 Anthropic 的 frontend-design 技能扩展而来。它提供 17 个精准指令和 7 个领域专项参考文件，涵盖排版、色彩、动效等设计维度，并内置反模式指南，有效规避模板化设计。支持 Cursor 等 AI 工具，显著提升生成 UI 的专业性与一致性。
repos.summary_en: Impeccable is a prompt engineering framework that enhances AI-driven frontend design by building on Anthropic's frontend-design skill. It offers 17 precise steering commands and 7 domain-specific reference files covering typography, color, motion, and UX writing, plus curated anti-patterns to avoid generic designs. Integrated with AI coding tools like Cursor, it ensures professional, consistent UI output.

repos.description: 丰富多样的 Web 弹出层组件，可轻松实现 Alert/Confirm/Prompt/ 普通提示/页面区块/iframe/tips等等几乎所有的弹出交互。目前已成为最多人使用的弹层解决方案
repos.summary_zh: layer 是一款功能全面的 Web 弹出层组件，支持 Alert、Confirm、Prompt、提示框、页面区块、iframe 等多种交互模式，兼容 IE6+ 及主流浏览器。现已集成至 Layui 框架，提供高性能、易定制的弹层解决方案，广泛应用于企业级 Web 项目，是开发者首选的轻量级交互组件。
repos.summary_en: Layer is a comprehensive web modal component supporting Alert, Confirm, Prompt, tips, iframe, and more. It offers high performance, cross-browser compatibility (including IE6), and extensive customization. Now fully integrated into Layui, it serves as a lightweight, developer-friendly solution for rich user interactions across millions of web platforms.

repos.description: Open-source Claude Design alternative. One-click import your Claude Code / Codex API key. Prompt → prototype / slides / PDF. Multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama). BYOK, local-first, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Open CoDesign 是一款开源的 Claude Design 替代工具，支持一键导入 Claude Code/Codex API 密钥，将提示词转换为原型、幻灯片或 PDF。支持多模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini/Kimi/GLM/Ollama），采用 BYOK 和本地优先架构，MIT 许可，适合 AI 驱动的设计自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Open CoDesign is an open-source alternative to Claude Design that converts prompts into polished prototypes, slides, or PDFs using your own API keys. Supports multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama), BYOK, and local-first architecture with MIT license for AI-powered design automation.

repos.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 智能体技能，支持 15+ 主流开发工具（如 Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）。通过中央仓库集中管理技能，支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件或市场导入，一键同步至目标工具，并提供场景分组、更新追踪和技能文档预览功能。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app that centralizes the management, sync, and organization of AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. It supports importing skills from Git repos, local folders, or the marketplace into a unified repository, enables one-click sync via symlinks/copies, and offers scenario grouping, update tracking, and in-app skill documentation preview.

repos.description: The Enterprise-Grade Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework. Website: https://swarms.ai

repos.description: Deployed on Cloudflare Worker, using the free Flux model and optimizing prompts with LLM. It can be called from any application compatible with the OpenAI API. 部署于Cloudflare Worker，免费使用Flux模型，并通过LLM进行提示词优化，支持在任何兼容OpenAI API的应用中调用。
repos.summary_zh: Flux-API-Worker 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Worker 上的 AI 图像生成服务，免费使用 Flux 模型并通过 LLM 优化提示词，提供兼容 OpenAI API 的接口，支持自定义提示、多尺寸输出、KV 缓存及 CORS，适用于各类应用集成。
repos.summary_en: Flux-API-Worker is an AI image generation service deployed on Cloudflare Workers, utilizing the free Flux model and LLM-powered prompt optimization. It offers an OpenAI-compatible API for seamless integration into any application, supporting custom prompts, multiple aspect ratios, KV storage, and streaming responses.

repos.summary_zh: 统一管理所有 AI 编码工具的 Skills，基于 Agent Skills 标准，支持 npx skills add 安装社区技能并自动同步。采用反向软链接架构，将真实 Git 仓库置于 ~/.agents/skills，通过 ~/Workspace/my-ai-skills 软链接实现便捷访问，同时自动为 Claude、Cursor、Codex 等 25+ 种 AI 工具建立技能链接，实现跨设备 Git 同步与多平台兼容。
repos.summary_en: Centralized management of AI coding agent skills based on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with npx skills add for installing community skills and automatic synchronization. Uses a reverse symlink architecture with the real Git repo at ~/.agents/skills, accessible via ~/Workspace/my-ai-skills symlink, while auto-creating skill links for 25+ tools like Claude, Cursor, and Codex, enabling cross-device Git sync and multi-platform compatibility.

repos.description: An open-source Agent Skill framework implementing progressive disclosure architecture
repos.summary_zh: OpenSkills SDK 是一个开源的 Agent 技能框架，采用渐进式披露架构实现 AI 智能体的模块化技能管理。支持三层加载机制（元数据/指令/资源）、多 LLM 提供商集成、脚本沙箱执行及自动文件同步，适用于构建可插拔、安全的智能体应用。
repos.summary_en: OpenSkills SDK is an open-source Agent Skill framework implementing progressive disclosure architecture for modular AI agent skills. It features three-layer loading (metadata/instruction/resources), multi-LLM provider support, sandboxed script execution, and automatic file sync, enabling secure and extensible intelligent agent applications.

repos.description: An open-source Agent Skill framework implementing progressive disclosure architecture
repos.summary_zh: OpenSkills SDK 是一个开源的 Agent 技能框架，采用渐进式披露架构实现 AI 代理技能的模块化开发与管理。支持三层加载机制（元数据/指令/资源）、智能引用加载、脚本沙箱执行及多模态输入处理，兼容主流 LLM 提供商，适用于构建可自动调用技能的智能代理系统。
repos.summary_en: OpenSkills SDK is an open-source Agent Skill framework implementing progressive disclosure architecture for modular AI agent skill development. It features three-layer loading (metadata/instruction/resources), smart reference management, sandboxed script execution, multimodal support, and compatibility with major LLM providers like OpenAI and Ollama.

repos.description: the first fount character in history
repos.summary_zh: GentianAphrodite 是首个基于 fount 框架的男性向 AI 角色包，专为角色扮演场景设计。其核心能力包括深度 NSFW 内容创作、多语言自适应人格、超能力设定及自动情境感知（如数学计算、文件解析、屏幕截图）。通过 Prompt 工程实现创意表达（诗歌、骂人模式）与元功能（Prompt 编写、语料生成），并集成 Agent 工具链支持网络搜索、代码执行与浏览器自动化，体现‘AI 与代码职责分离’架构理念。
repos.summary_en: GentianAphrodite is the first AI character built for the fount framework, designed as a male-oriented roleplay agent. It features inherent traits like absolute owner priority, multilingual adaptability, and NSFW expertise, alongside fantasy abilities such as shape-shifting. Powered by prompt engineering, it enables creative modes (poetry, rudeness) and meta-functions (prompt writing). Automated features handle math, file parsing, and screenshots, while proactive tools include web search, code execution, and browser automation—all reflecting a clear separation between deterministic logic and AI creativity.

repos.description: 怎样利用claude skills 简单的实现一个适合自己的“微舆”？适合自己的简单“微舆” 。社媒+深度调研 2个skills 合体 的 agent智能体：AI启动了 Web Search 和 via TikHub （社交媒体）进行深度调研 ，2个skills都正常调用了。  2个skills 混合在一起合体使用
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库构建了一个基于 Claude Code 智能体的社交媒体深度研究系统，结合 Web Search 与 TikHub API 实现多平台数据采集。通过并行子智能体架构，支持对 TikTok、微博、知乎等14+平台进行跨文化影响力分析，自动生成带引用的结构化研究报告，适用于品牌监测、舆情分析及人物影响力评估。
repos.summary_en: This repository implements a social media research system using Claude Code agents integrated with TikHub API for multi-platform data collection. It employs parallel sub-agents to analyze 14+ platforms like TikTok and Weibo, generating structured reports with citations for cross-cultural influence studies, brand monitoring, and public figure impact assessments.

repos.description: 油猴 chatgpt Prompt 脚本插件，在chatgpt聊天框导入Prompt 对话框
repos.summary_zh: 该油猴脚本为 ChatGPT 网页端提供中文 Prompt 训练对话框插件，支持一键导入预设角色提示词，提升交互效率。基于 GreasyFork 部署，集成 Docusaurus 搜索功能并优化 PC 端中文输入延迟问题。强调使用英文提示词以获得更稳定输出，建议添加 'respond in Chinese' 控制回复语言。
repos.summary_en: A Tampermonkey script that adds a Chinese Prompt training dialog to ChatGPT's web interface, enabling one-click import of role-based prompts for enhanced productivity. Hosted on GreasyFork with Docusaurus-powered search, it addresses PC-side input lag via debounce. Recommends English prompts for reliability and supports language control via 'respond in Chinese'.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.

repos.description: A script with html interface, generating Anki decks from the Language Reactor CSV export.
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本通过HTML界面将Language Reactor插件导出的CSV文件转换为Anki记忆卡片，利用AI大模型生成结构化数据（含词汇、例句、翻译等），支持多语言及日语假名标注，实现语言学习内容的自动化处理与知识图谱构建。
repos.summary_en: This script processes CSV exports from the Language Reactor Chrome extension via an HTML interface, using AI prompts to generate structured Anki flashcards with words, contexts, synonyms, translations, examples, and explanations—supporting multiple languages including Japanese with furigana support for automated language learning workflows.
